items.title: Trump vows to 'respond' after US helicopter shot down by Iran
items.description: US President Donald Trump has blamed Iran for shooting down a US Apache helicopter that was patrolling the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: Eight killed in south Lebanon strike as Israel warns entire city to evacuate
items.description: For the first time, Israel's military has warned the entire city of Tyre to evacuate forcing thousands of people to flee.

items.title: These cranes are battery-powered as firms increasingly ditch diesel
items.description: The Iran war and the oil supply squeeze are supercharging business investment in renewables.

items.title: UK police arrest man over 'barbaric' knife attack in Belfast
items.description: Police say a Sudanese man in his 30s has been arrested on suspicion of attempted murder after a "brutal" knife attack in Belfast.

items.title: 'Going to end up dead': Warning for teens using apps to commit crimes
items.description: Criminal syndicates are targeting vulnerable children with no criminal history, low IQ and intellectual disabilities to carry out their dirty work through encrypted apps.

items.title: 'We didn't know how dangerous he was': How Rolf Harris hid in plain sight

items.title: Foord scores in game 150 as Matildas beat Mexico
items.description: The Matildas earned a 3-1 victory in a frenetic contest against a game Mexican side, as Caitlin Foord scored in her milestone match.

items.title: Search for survivors as deadly Philippines quake displaces tens of thousands

items.title: UN inquiry finds Israeli forces shield settlers during attacks on Palestinians
items.description: A UN report finds that Palestinians are being subjected to "mass atrocities" by Israeli forces and being "violently repressed and controlled by the very faction that claims to govern them".

items.title: Western Sydney International Airport opening date announced
items.description: After 15 years of planning, seven years of construction and a year of testing, Western Sydney International Airport has confirmed its opening date for passengers.

items.title: Victim-survivors tear up agreement with Catholic church
items.description: Victim-survivors of clergy abuse say negotiations and agreements reached with the Catholic Diocese of Ballarat are now null and void.

items.title: Escaped devil spotted on suburban Gold Coast CCTV after week on loose
items.description: A two-year-old Tasmanian devil has been on the loose since last Tuesday when she leapt out of her enclosure at a Gold Coast wildlife park.

items.description: It will shut its 62 company-owned stores in the coming weeks and working through "transitional arrangements" with 27 stores owned by franchises, with hundreds of staff facing redundancy.

items.title: No friends but a Commonwealth Games berth? Worth it, says Sienna Toohey
items.description: Seventeen-year-old Sienna Toohey says qualifying for the Commonwealth Games makes moving away from friends and family to Canberra worth it.

items.title: Finding and saving the world's biggest trees before they disappear

items.title: Quiz: Stow your luggage in the locker overhead, we're off to see the world
items.description: The lek is the currency of which country? And what's the Japanese word for pufferfish, the sashimi delicacy that's toxic if prepared incorrectly?

items.title: Calling all budding storytellers living with disability
items.description: If you are an emerging content maker or journalist with disability and have a story to tell, now is your chance to work with the ABC to tell it.

items.title: The Big Issue celebrates three decades in Australia with special edition

items.title: Year 12 students in Melbourne caught cheating using AI

items.title: New Apple child safety features 'part inspired' by Australia social media ban

items.title: Aussie star calls out $130k prize money disparity at tennis tournament
items.description: Priscilla Hon draws attention to the difference between the men's and women's winners' prize money at the Libéma Open in The Netherlands.

items.title: Mongols fugitive taken down by dog squad after fleeing traffic stop on foot
items.description: Police have arrested fugitive Top End Mongols bikie Brandt Graham five days after the 44-year-old escaped from custody last week, sparking an "extensive manhunt".

items.title: Police say 17yo fired 30 shots at wrong funeral venue for Sydney crime boss
